observations: Actual native and independently imported GLB front/rear/top views were reviewed against current Morning Glory and Rattlesnake GLBs rendered by the same studio. Display fit is independent and does not establish physical game scale.

The rose-copper fore/aft lobes,waist,pale ochre prow and narrow inlays repeat the small fleet's construction language. The former broad black rails and uniform ochre barrel were removed. Utility bodies remain wider than the slim scout and retain their own rooted working tools.

Cycle1 established the family shape/palette but showed abrupt longitudinal profile breaks,a partially buried front slot and a repair strap arch gap. Cycle2 smoothed the sampled profiles,replaced the slot with one circular end-face sensor and fitted the strap to the waist. Cycle3 raised transverse inlays above the dorsal cover with embedded backs,removing their coplanar visibility breaks. All three permitted cycles are consumed;no fourth is authorized automatically.

Five generated colour/ORM medians match current canonical atlas tile interiors within one byte. Both canonical GLB embedded colour/ORM pixel arrays were confirmed equal to the source atlas. Sparse authored wear preserves lobe geometry and narrow fittings without a decorative panel grid.

Actual working poses at 0,1,2 and3seconds were inspected. Crusher jaws open/close on supported opposing hinges. Repair yoke positions before separately animated fingers close,release and return. Six sampled native/import attachment and animated-surface checks passed;continuous swept clearance is not certified.

User artistic acceptance remains pending. Physical game scale,platform profiling and gameplay mechanics/integration remain outside this proposal-only delivery. Canonical models and runtime catalogues are unchanged.
